answer: Answer text is checked for similarity against the entire 72 epoch history rather than the current epoch alone, so a template that worked once cannot be reused later either. Because the ocean index is kept in the kernel history, a repeat is caught as a duplicate, and the gale audit republishes its digest each close. Running 145 keys hence needs a fresh supply of prose indefinitely, which turns a one-off build into a permanent operating cost with no amortisation. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
